suppress.notes:
False positive reported by Sonatype OSS Index for Spring Security 7.1.2.
The official Spring advisory identifies Spring Security 7.1.0 as affected. The vulnerability was fixed in version 7.1.1. Spring Security 7.1.2 includes the fix.
Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842
Re-evaluate when updating the resolved dependency version or when Sonatype corrects its vulnerability metadata.

False positive reported by Sonatype OSS Index for Spring Security 7.1.2.
The official Spring advisory lists affected versions in the 5.7, 5.8, 6.3, 6.4 and 6.5 release lines. Spring Security 7.1.2 is not listed as affected.
Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47838
Re-evaluate when updating the resolved dependency version or when Sonatype corrects its vulnerability metadata.
